proposed_widenings.name: freeze_deadline
proposed_widenings.justification: Gentle Repose suspends the countdown timer of another effect (the 10-day Raise Dead resurrection window) for as long as Gentle Repose persists. No existing EffectAtom models pausing or suspending the elapsed-time progress of an adjacent spell or effect. block_reanimation only flags the corpse as an invalid reanimation source; it does not interact with Raise Dead's deadline at all.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The spell also effectively extends the time limit on raising the target from the dead, since days spent under the influence of this spell don't count against the time limit of spells such as Raise Dead.

notes: Primary mechanic (block_reanimation) encodes cleanly; the atom was added to types.ts specifically for this spell. The decay-protection clause is pure narrative (DM agenda, no atom needed). The Raise Dead timer-freeze clause is the missing atom: it requires cross-spell deadline interaction that v4 has no atom for. The encoded trace is honest for the two encodable mechanics (block_reanimation + timed-persist lifecycle). One secondary mechanic is omitted with documentation.
